basics.name: Conor Hinchee
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 5+ years of experience building ecommerce applications in React, GraphQL and TypeScript, and analytics in GA4. I've handled on-call rotations and troubleshoot production systems in real time with Google Cloud and TrackJS. Lately I've been building AI harnesses and tools that help developers get work done.

keywords: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Webpack, Storybook

keywords: Node.js, GraphQL, Apollo Server, Apollo Client, Express.js, GCP Cloud Functions, Firebase, Supabase, CommerceTools API

keywords: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, GA4, TrackJS, Google Cloud Logging

keywords: Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Claude Code skills, Anthropic SDK

highlights: Led the move to Google Retail Search, which replaced keyword matching with ML-ranked results and raised search-to-purchase conversion.
Own the storefront product carousel. I rebuilt it from scratch with fewer re-renders, which improved Core Web Vitals across the site.
One of four npm maintainers on pure-react-carousel (express-labs), about 67k weekly downloads and 1.7k GitHub stars. I triage issues, review community PRs and publish releases.
Keep the components I own at 100% unit test coverage with Jest and React Testing Library, so regressions get caught before staging.
Mentor junior engineers through code review and pairing. Two of them now own features on their own.
Take on-call shifts: I troubleshoot production issues in real time with Google Cloud and TrackJS, lead the response and write the postmortem.
Solved high-volume support issues on the first call for non-technical customers.

projects.name: Odin, Claude Code Skill
projects.description: A Claude Code skill for AI coding work: plan, execute, review, then sign-off, with a human approval gate between each step. A local dashboard shows a live diff with a written rationale. Anything that took more than one pass becomes a proposed fix to the agent's own rules.

projects.name: heap-analyzer
projects.description: A CLI wrapper around Facebook's memlab that finds memory leaks in Node.js apps. It diffs three heap snapshots and traces what keeps each leaked object alive.
